verdict.rationale: LiveKit has a first-party CLI reference page (developer-tools/livekit-cli) that documents scaffolding an agent, talking to it locally, and deploying it to LiveKit Cloud. The GitHub README adds that the tool gives access to server APIs, token creation, test-traffic generation and agent scaffolding and deployment. missing for 10: a detailed command reference or installation docs in the evidence, explicit evidence that the tool suits AI or coding-agent driven workflows (e.g. machine-readable output), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Scaffold an agent, talk to it locally, and deploy it to LiveKit Cloud:
server APIs, create tokens, generate test traffic, and scaffold and deploy agents.
